content:
CORNER Sales One-Pager

Author: Steve (AI Advisory Lead) Date: 2026-03-16 For: Steffen (design), Bobby (web version), Patrik (sales tool) Format: Print-ready PDF (letter size, both sides) + web version at corner.app/one-pager or aheadofmarket.com/one-pager Purpose: The thing you hand someone after a demo. The thing you attach to a follow-up email. The thing that sits on their desk for a week and reminds them to call you.

Design Direction (For Steffen)

  • AOM brand. White, clean, high contrast. "Heaven" aesthetic.
  • No clutter. Every word earns its space.
  • Big type for headlines. Body at 11-12pt minimum for print.
  • "Old people can read em, young people love em."
  • Small isometric Corner illustration in the header or footer (decorative, not dominant).
  • QR code bottom-right of page 1: links to aheadofmarket.com/book
  • AOM logo, contact info, website in footer of both sides.

Page 1 (Front): The Pitch

Header

CORNER Your AI operations team.

Hero Statement

You run the business. Corner runs the back office.

Corner gives small businesses a team of AI agents that handles scheduling, client follow-up, estimating support, outreach, content, and quality control. 24/7. For less than one part-time employee.

Three Columns (equal width)

Column 1: The Problem

  • 15-20 hrs/week on admin
  • Leads fall through cracks
  • Client follow-up is inconsistent
  • You're the bottleneck for everything

Column 2: The Solution

  • 6+ AI agents working for you
  • Automatic scheduling and follow-up
  • Real-time operations dashboard
  • Works while you sleep

Column 3: The Proof

  • Built by AOM for our own business
  • Running daily for 6+ months
  • 14 agents, real tasks, real output
  • Now available for your business

The Numbers (horizontal bar or callout box)

What You Spend What Corner Costs What You Save
15-20 hrs/week on admin $3,000/month 10+ hrs/week back
$4-6k/month for one hire Less than one part-time salary ROI positive in month 1

CTA

See it live. 15 minutes. Book a demo: aheadofmarket.com/book [QR Code]

Page 2 (Back): The Details

How It Works (4 Steps, Numbered)

1. We audit your operations. ($2,500, 2 weeks) We learn your business inside and out. You get a written report showing exactly where AI saves you the most time and money.

2. We build your Corner office. Based on the audit, we configure your AI team: the right agents, the right skills, the right workflows for your business. We do the setup. You don't touch code.

3. You open your dashboard. An isometric office where you see your agents working in real time. Click any agent to chat. Check off tasks. Watch your operations run.

4. We manage everything. Monthly optimization, new automations as needs emerge, monitoring, updates. Your system gets smarter over time. We handle it all.

What Your AI Team Can Do (Two columns, bullet lists)

Operations

  • Schedule jobs and appointments
  • Follow up with clients automatically
  • Track your project pipeline
  • Send estimates and invoices
  • Manage your calendar
  • Route tasks to the right person

Growth

  • Draft and send outreach emails
  • Create social media content
  • Track leads and opportunities
  • Generate proposals
  • Monitor client health
  • Produce reports and analytics

Pricing (Simple, 3 options)

Audit Growth Scale
Price $2,500 (one-time) $3,000/month $5,000/month
What you get 2-week ops analysis + written report 6 AI agents + full dashboard 10+ agents + priority support
Best for "Show me the value first" Most businesses Growing companies

Social Proof (1-2 lines)

"AOM built an AI operations system that runs our entire back office. 14 agents. Every day. We're not selling theory. We're selling what works." -- Patrik Matheson, AOM

Footer

AOM | Ahead of Market aheadofmarket.com | hello@aom-inhouse.com Phoenix, AZ

Web Version Notes (For Bobby)

The web version at /one-pager should:

  • Render the same content as the PDF but responsive
  • Include the same QR code (or just a prominent CTA button on web)
  • Be shareable via URL (this is what Patrik texts or emails)
  • Include a "Download PDF" button that triggers a clean PDF download
  • Match the print design as closely as possible
  • Load fast. No heavy animations. This is a sales tool, not a showcase.

Distribution

Patrik uses this:

  1. After every demo. Email the PDF within 1 hour of the meeting ending. Subject: "What we talked about + next steps"
  2. At networking events. Print copies. Hand them out. The QR code drives to /book.
  3. In cold email follow-ups. When a prospect replies with interest, attach the PDF.
  4. In the proposal. Include as the first page of any formal proposal.

Production Checklist

  • Steffen: design both sides in Figma/PDF format
  • Bobby: build web version at /one-pager
  • Patrik: review and approve
  • Print 50 copies for networking
  • PDF uploaded to aheadofmarket.com for download

This is the most important single page in the entire sales process. It's the thing the prospect looks at when they're deciding whether to call back. Make it clean, make it clear, make it impossible to ignore.
